subject: gk
question:
Read the below statements marked as Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Mark the correct option:

Assertion (A): The population enumeration phase of Census 2011 was carried out largely in February 2011.

Reason (R): The housing census phase was delayed to align both exercises together.

options.text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true

solution:
The Correct answer is __**A is true, but R is false**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Census of India** is conducted in two phases: the **House Listing and Housing Census** phase and the **Population Enumeration** phase.
 
• The **Population Enumeration phase** of Census 2011 was indeed carried out largely in **February 2011**, as part of the decadal census exercise.
 
• The **Housing Census phase**, however, was not delayed to align with the Population Enumeration phase. It was conducted much earlier, in **2010**.
 
• Thus, the assertion that the Population Enumeration phase was carried out largely in February 2011 is **true**.
 
• The reason that the Housing Census phase was delayed to align both exercises is **false**, as there was no delay in the Housing Census.
 
• This makes the correct option: **A is true, but R is false**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Census of India:**

 
 
• It is conducted every **10 years** by the **Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, India**, under the Ministry of Home Affairs.
 
• The Census provides detailed data on **population, housing, literacy, employment, and more**.
 
• The Census 2011 was the **15th National Census** of India.
 
 
 
• **Housing Census:**
 
 
• This is the first phase of the Census and focuses on collecting data related to **households, housing conditions, and amenities.**
 
• For Census 2011, the Housing Census was conducted in the year **2010.**
 
 
 
• **Population Enumeration:**
 
 
• This is the second phase of the Census and involves **counting every individual residing in the country** during the reference period.
 
• For Census 2011, the Population Enumeration phase was conducted in **February 2011.**
